name: SHIRMANI Product Media Production Contract
purpose: Customer-facing production standard for every concrete digital product.
truth_boundary: Presentation media demonstrates and explains a product. It is not independent scientific verification.
production_principle: Produce concrete customer-facing output first; QC/gate/dispatch are downstream release controls; reviews/ratings feed quality improvement.
continuity: Scheduled GitHub Actions continue without a new chat message, subject to platform limits, permissions and workflow health.
